answer: Randomly re-grade a sample of already-scored answers with an independent panel, then flag any grader whose marks wander sharply from the sampled consensus. A rubber-stamp grader that passes everything stains the sample like umber smeared across pale rock: its scores diverge statistically however it hides. An honest grader tracks the panel across a whole canyon of samples and survives; a colluding one accrues deviation and is slashed, all from a cheap random draw.
